info.name: Microsoft Office 365 Microsoft Graph Calendar Groups API

params.name: $top
params.description: The number of items to return in a result set. Maximum value depends on the API.

params.name: $skip
params.description: The number of items to skip in the result set.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to restrict the set of items returned.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties for sorting results.

params.name: $search
params.description: Search expression to filter results. Uses KQL syntax for directory objects.

params.name: $count
params.description: Include a count of the total number of items in a collection alongside the page of data values.

params.name: $expand
params.description: Comma-separated list of relationships to expand and include in the response.

items.docs: List all groups in an organization, including Microsoft 365 groups, security groups, and distribution groups. Returns up to 100 objects by default. To return additional properties, use $select. Requires GroupMember.Read.All, Group.Read.All, or Directory.Read.All permission.

Create a new Microsoft 365 group or security group. You can create Microsoft 365 groups with a team, a channel, or both by specifying the resourceProvisioningOptions. Requires Group.ReadWrite.All or Directory.ReadWrite.All permission.

params.name: group-id
params.description: The unique identifier of the group (GUID).

items.docs: Get the properties and relationships of a group object. Returns a default set of properties; use $select to request additional properties. Requires GroupMember.Read.All, Group.Read.All, or Directory.Read.All permission.

items.docs: Update the properties of a group object. Requires Group.ReadWrite.All or Directory.ReadWrite.All permission. Not every property can be updated.

items.docs: Delete a group. When deleted, Microsoft 365 groups are moved to a temporary container and can be restored within 30 days. Security groups and distribution groups are permanently deleted immediately. Requires Group.ReadWrite.All or Directory.ReadWrite.All permission.

params.description: The unique identifier of the group (GUID).

items.docs: Get a list of the group's direct members. A group can have users, organizational contacts, devices, service principals, and other groups as members. Requires GroupMember.Read.All, Group.Read.All, or Directory.Read.All permission.

params.name: group-id
params.description: The unique identifier of the group (GUID).

items.docs: Add a member to a Microsoft 365 group or a security group through the members navigation property. You can add users, organizational contacts, service principals, or other groups. Requires GroupMember.ReadWrite.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, or Directory.ReadWrite.All permission.

params.name: group-id
params.description: The unique identifier of the group (GUID).

params.name: directoryObject-id
params.description: The unique identifier of the directory object (member) to remove.

items.docs: Remove a member from a group via the members navigation property. Requires GroupMember.ReadWrite.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, or Directory.ReadWrite.All permission.
